title: Topic 2.1: Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare

pages.lesson:
LESSON: ENLIGHTENED BEINGS AND SOCIAL WELFARE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Enlightened Beings
Topic 2.1: Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare
2. Practise Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare in the examples.
2. Explain Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare
2. Practise Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Enlightened Beings and Social Welfare

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
